name: Vandana Kumar

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Vandana Kumar is a Delhi-based French teacher, poet, translator and film producer. The National Book Trust's 2025 fair programme introduces her through this combination of education, cinema and writing. Her debut poetry collection, Mannequin of Our Times, was published by World Inkers Printing and Publishing; its everyday settings open onto questions about contemporary life.

Her Kabita Live poems resist easy reassurance. Monday blues on a Friday questions whether still water and familiar smiles can really comfort a person, ending with a search for restorative turbulence. A poem Saved gives a different kind of urgency to the task of undoing learned hatred. Its comparison with a medical emergency makes the work of education and unlearning feel immediate and necessary.
